subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Data handling: Collect, represent and analyse data
source.subtopic: Represent data in tables and bar graphs

show.line: This bar graph shows our favourite fruit. The tallest bar is bananas. Most children chose bananas!

rounds.prompt: Which fruit got the most votes? Tap it.
rounds.praise: Yes! The banana bar is the tallest.

rounds.prompt: Read the graph. How many children chose apples?
rounds.praise: Four! The apple bar reaches four.

rounds.prompt: Which pet got the fewest votes?
rounds.praise: Yes! The fish bar is the shortest.

rounds.prompt: Dogs got six votes. Cats got four. How many more chose dogs? Say the number.
Here is a table. Three children walk, seven ride a taxi. Which bar graph matches?
rounds.praise: Yes! The taxi bar is taller.

rounds.prompt: Count the tally marks for soccer.
rounds.praise: Seven! A bundle of five and two more.

hints: A taller bar means more. A shorter bar means fewer.
Read the number at the top of the bar.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the favourite fruit.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Apples! The apple bar is the shortest, so it wins!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The tallest bar wins. Bananas got the most votes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. The banana bar is the tallest. Most children chose bananas!

parent_line: Can read a bar graph and a tally table.
